Measured: cooldown 0.4785 -> 0.200 (Airstrike 46.1s -> 71.9s) and blastRadius +0.3 -> 0.250. IMPORTANT CLAMP CORRECTION at place 493: 'negative floor 0' cannot apply to stats whose benefit IS a negative value. Every recoil augment is negative (-0.10 to -0.25) and adsSpeed's only augment is -0.08, so the floor-0 clamp added at place 490 was silently deleting those stats entirely. recoil, adsSpeed and movingAccuracy (which carries both signs in the data) now clamp symmetrically to [-cap, +cap]; the rest still floor at 0. ROOT CAUSE identified at place 504: the clamps fight data authored at 3-8x the specified magnitudes (see S11-042), which is why two stacked augments overshoot a 20-25% cap immediately and why clamped augments feel far weaker than their displayed ranges.
